title: Hreflang Check
summary: Checks hreflang tags or a sitemap against Google's rules, so missing return links or bad codes don't get the whole set ignored.
description: Checks pasted <link> tags or a sitemap for one page or a set, following Google Search Central: a who-links-to-whom grid, missing return links, invalid codes (en-UK, es-419), relative URLs, missing self-reference or x-default, and canonicals to another language, with fixes.
catches: Missing or near-miss return links between versions
Codes Google doesn't support: en-UK, es-419, region-only codes
A canonical pointing at another language's page
limits: Checks only what you paste; it does not crawl live pages or HTTP Link headers
Follows Google's documented rules; other search engines may differ
Can't tell whether page content actually matches the declared language
a11y: Text area has a label, aria-invalid when errors exist, and is described by the hint and status
Status uses role=status; icons are aria-hidden
The link grid is a table with row and column headers and a text description in each cell
Focus returns to a nearby button after a fix

sources.label: Google Search Central: Tell Google about localized versions of your page

rules.note: Informational; check the official source. Confirmed: return links, self-reference, fully-qualified URLs, ISO 639-1 + ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (es-419 unsupported, UK not a valid region), optional ISO 15924 script, x-default.

stops: Helps catch hreflang tags Google would ignore
